spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 22}, {@hit 14} to hit with spell attacks):
will: {@spell Shapechange|SRD52} (Beast or Humanoid form only, no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52} gained from the spell, and no {@status Concentration|SRD52} or {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52} required to maintain the spell)

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Repulsion Breath or (B) Spellcasting to cast {@spell Guiding Bolt|SRD52} (level 2 version).

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 16}, reach 15 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d8 + 9}) Slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Lightning damage.

action.name: Lightning Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 23}, each creature in a 120-foot-long, 10-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 82 ({@damage 15d10}) Lightning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Repulsion Breath
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 23}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} The target is pushed up to 60 feet straight away from the dragon and has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

legendary.name: Guiding Light
entries: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast {@spell Guiding Bolt|SRD52} (level 2 version).

legendary.name: Pounce
entries: The dragon moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}, and it makes one Rend attack.

legendary.name: Thunderclap
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 22}, each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Sphere} centered on a point the dragon can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Deafened|SRD52} condition until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The dragon makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

Ancient bronze dragons develop dramatic patinas on their glimmering scales. These dragons strive to protect whole regions, continents, or planets from threats. They seek solutions to planes-spanning calamities or multiversal perils and oppose the evil of mighty chromatic dragons.

items.title: An ancient bronze dragon uses its repulsion breath to protect a community from rampaging Water elementals
